Hi Karthik,

Thanks for taking this. Peregrine is preparing for a SIG assessment in Q2 and we want to run a focused walkthrough with Redwoods' security owners to align on the evidence handoff and sampling windows. High-level asks:

- Quick walk of the dataflow and where PHI/non-PHI are stored/transit (diagram preferred)
- KMS key management model and whether we can get a read-only timeline of key rotations for the last 12 months
- Sample log export windows and retention proof for containerized inference (short-term retention questions from our auditors)
- A list of owners and preferred contact for evidence uploads (S3 / secure share)

I've attached a preliminary SIG matrix (peregrine_prelim_sig.xlsx) with questions we've started filling out — won't take long to review during the call. Are you available this week for a 45 minute walkthrough? Prefer Tue/Wed mornings PT.

Thanks,
Anna Morales
Security Engineer, Peregrine Therapeutics

Hi Karthik — Wed 09:00 PT works for us.

A couple of clarifications before the call so we make good use of time:
- For KMS, auditors typically want key IDs, creation date, rotation timestamps, and the Principal (service account) used for daily operations. If you can provide a sample audit log extract (timestamps + event type), that would be ideal.
- For log samples: we need a 24-hour window export that includes request IDs, model IDs, and authentication principal (pseudonymized okay). Is that possible to stage ahead of the call? Even a synthetic but structurally-identical sample helps.
- Evidence handoff: we prefer S3 presigned links to a Peregrine-controlled bucket and a manifest CSV listing files + checksums.

I've flagged a few high-priority rows in the spreadsheet and added comments. See attached.

Thanks — looking forward to the walkthrough.
Jake
Security Manager, Peregrine Therapeutics

Thanks everyone for a productive session this morning. Notes and owners below — forwarding the recording + artifacts once final checks are done.

Meeting notes (31 Mar 2026, 09:00 PT):
- Attendees: Karthik Iyer (Redwood), Laura Bennett (Redwood), Ben Carter (Redwood CS), Anna Morales (Peregrine), Jake Sullivan (Peregrine)
- Scope: SIG v2/Caiq-focused walkthrough; primary focus on dataflow, KMS rotation evidence, and log export samples.

Key takeaways:
1) Dataflow: We walked through redwood_dataflow_v2.pdf. Critical paths: upload -> preprocessing (ephemeral containers) -> inference runtime -> optional persistent artifact store. No PHI persisted by default; where customers choose to persist outputs, those are stored in a tenant-scoped encrypted blob store.

2) KMS: Redwood uses a centralized KMS provider (cloud-KMS) with customer-specific key aliases. We cannot export private key material. What we can provide: key IDs, creation/rotation timestamps, and an audit extract showing "GenerateDataKeyCalled" and "RotateKey" events. Laura will prepare a redacted sample audit extract.

3) Logs & sampling: Ben confirmed we can generate a 24-hour synthetic sample with fields requested (request_id, model_id, auth_principal, timestamp). For actual production samples we require a signed request from Peregrine's compliance officer — but synthetic samples suffice for structural review.

4) Evidence handoff: Preferred flow agreed: Redwood stages files to a secure staging bucket and provides presigned S3 URLs plus a manifest CSV (filename, sha256, size, owner). Peregrine will ingest into their bucket.

Action items (owner — due):
- Laura Bennett: produce redacted KMS audit extract (kms_audit_sample.csv) — due 2026-04-02
- Ben Carter: generate 24h synthetic log sample and manifest (logs_sample_20260315.jsonl) — due 2026-04-02
- Karthik Iyer: produce evidence handoff runbook (handoff_runbook.md) and final dataflow PDF without internal IP (for external distribution) — due 2026-04-02
- Anna Morales: confirm exact audit fields Peregrine needs for KMS extract (email reply) — due 2026-04-01

Attachments to follow: redwood_dataflow_v2.pdf (shared during call), and a draft handoff template.

Recording and files: We will share the recording and the artifact bundle via secure link by EOD.

Regards,
Karthik
